methods.name: baseline_vid
methods.label: Existing VID
methods.explanation: Population-rate overlap using the per-EDP VID reaches.

methods.name: pair_fixed_divide
methods.label: Pair-aware fixed
methods.explanation: Constant bounded capture rates with pair-specific effects.

methods.name: pair_log_shared_divide
methods.label: Pair-aware fixed + shared log
methods.explanation: Pair-specific effects plus one campaign-size slope.

methods.name: pair_log_order_divide
methods.label: Pair-aware order-specific log
methods.explanation: A separate campaign-size slope for every intersection order.

methods.name: shape_spline_divide
methods.label: Shape-constrained scale spline
methods.explanation: A smooth monotone campaign-size response instead of one log slope.

methods.name: hierarchical_pair_divide
methods.label: Hierarchical EDP + pair effects
methods.explanation: EDP main effects plus strongly pooled pair residuals.

methods.name: low_rank_divide
methods.label: Low-rank EDP affinity
methods.explanation: Two shared dimensions represent recurring EDP affinity patterns.

methods.name: three_group_divide
methods.label: Three-group mixture
methods.explanation: Adds a middle matchability group to the two-group model.

methods.name: pairwise_maxent_logit
methods.label: Pairwise inference: logit calibration
methods.explanation: Calibrate only the 45 pairs, then infer all higher orders by maximum entropy.

methods.name: pairwise_maxent_direct
methods.label: Pairwise inference: direct calibration
methods.explanation: Uses bounded c=a+b log(size) pair calibration before maximum-entropy inference.

methods.name: pairwise_maxent_mixture
methods.label: Pairwise inference: two-group mixture
methods.explanation: Uses the two-group mixture to calibrate pairs, then infers higher orders by maximum entropy.

methods.name: oracle_pairwise_maxent
methods.label: Oracle pairwise closure (diagnostic)
methods.explanation: Uses true synthetic pairs to isolate the irreducible error from inferring higher orders from pairs.

methods.name: joint_two_group_exact
methods.label: Joint two-group pattern decoder
methods.explanation: Fits all true Venn cells directly to the observed multi-EDP Reference-ID patterns.

methods.name: joint_three_group_exact
methods.label: Joint three-group pattern decoder
methods.explanation: Joint pattern decoding with three person-level matchability groups.

methods.name: joint_low_rank_inclusive
methods.label: Joint low-rank inclusive decoder
methods.explanation: Fits one audience table to all inclusive overlaps using low-rank capture rates.

methods.name: joint_mixture_affinity
methods.label: Joint mixture + low-rank affinity
methods.explanation: Adds repeatable EDP-pair residual affinity to the joint mixture response.

methods.name: bayesian_map_affinity
methods.label: Bayesian/MAP joint affinity
methods.explanation: Poisson-IRLS MAP approximation with a weak prior around the baseline audience table.

notes: The Bayesian result is a deterministic Poisson-IRLS MAP approximation, not MCMC.
Pairwise maximum entropy infers higher orders but cannot identify higher-order interactions absent from the pairs.
Synthetic errors are not production accuracy estimates.
